Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel game player animation source sheet, to be cropped into 25 independent 32x48 logical-pixel PNGs.
Create exactly one 5-column by 5-row sprite sheet on real transparent alpha. Every cell occupies an equal 192x288 pixel rectangle (a 6x nearest-neighbor display of a 32x48 sprite), total canvas 960x1440 if supported, otherwise preserve the exact 5:5 cell layout ratio 2:3. No border, labels, text, guides or shadows. Columns left to right: idle, walk1, walk2, walk3, walk4. Rows top to bottom: E (faces right), SE (faces down-right), S (faces camera/front), NE (faces up-right/back), N (faces away/back). This is a straight upright body on square top-down world ground, never isometric and never full overhead.
Same one adult coastal wasteland survivor throughout: faded olive jacket, muted taupe canvas backpack, dark brown trousers, dark boots, short dark hair, a small warm yellow #c9a65e armband. No gun, no weapon, no hands gripping a weapon; shoulders and relaxed arms are visible. Body is about 38 logical pixels high, head starts near y=9, foot baseline at boundary y=48, feet centered at x=16; keep identical height and baseline in all frames. Four distinct walk poses with alternating feet and arm swing: walk1 and walk3 are opposite strides and body sinks one logical pixel; walk2 and walk4 are opposite passing poses. Do NOT duplicate frames. All figures wholly contained within their own cells and registered to the same centerline and baseline.
Authentic carefully hand-clustered 32x48 pixel art enlarged 6x with hard square pixel edges; compact readable silhouette, sparse one-pixel detail and 3-5 shade ramps. Low-saturation gray-brown coastal concrete/olive color family: #242321 #393733 #4b4842 #777268 #a49b88 #75634e #784d3d #a27351 #59604a #c9c0ac, modest skin tones. Light from upper left, dark right edge, no baked cast shadow, no ambient glow, no gradient or antialiasing, no faux transparency checkerboard. This sheet is production trial art, not a screenshot or character illustration.
wall: Create a square pixel-art MATERIAL PARTS CONTACT SHEET for a muted wet subtropical urban-village top-down game. Transparent background, no text, no grid, no shadows, no perspective, no isometric faces. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, 12 equal cells with generous empty gutters; row-major 11 centered isolated components, last cell empty. Render each at crisp native pixel style enlarged nearest-neighbor, no antialiasing. Components in this exact order: (1) square 32x32 opaque dark gray stone wall TOP CORE seen directly from above, a 3-color limestone ramp #4B4842 #777268 #A49B88; (2) thin horizontal 32x3 north edge strip, pale upper-left face; (3) thin horizontal 32x3 south edge strip, dark face; (4) thin vertical 3x32 east edge strip dark; (5) thin vertical 3x32 west edge strip pale. Row2: (6) vertical rectangular 32x48 EXTERIOR FACADE A dull concrete with salt chips, hairline crack and darker damp bottom 9 pixels; (7) vertical rectangular32x48 exterior facade B similar restrained concrete, tiny rust and salt with damp bottom9; (8) vertical rectangular32x48 INTERIOR PLASTER WALL light worn gray-beige top30pixels, gray-green bottom18; (9) vertical rectangular32x48 WINDOW WALL straight front elevation, window24pixels wide centered in upper portion, very dark desaturated green-blue glass, thin anti-theft bars, low stone sill. Row3: (10) vertical32x48 CLOSED DOOR WALL, centered22x44 door opening occupied by dull brown wooden closed leaf, small handle; (11) vertical32x48 OPEN DOOR WALL same frame, centered22x44 aperture must be completely transparent, narrow4pixel leaf open flush to LEFT frame, NO opaque dark filling inside the aperture; (12) EMPTY. All source components front-facing orthographic upright facades except top core, no cast shadows or baked AO. Palette rusty #784D3D #A27351, slate #394B50 #687B7B, plaster#C9C0AC, dark#242321 #393733, concrete#4B4842 #777268 #A49B88, lower damp green#59604A, wood#75634E. Keep 3 to5 tones per material, sparse weathering, no labels or logos or people. Transparent empty space outside components. These are separate construction parts, NOT complete assembled houses. Do not combine edge strips with core.
ground: Create ONE pixel-art terrain swatch contact sheet, SIX separate square seamless ground tiles arranged exactly3columns x2rows, generous TRANSPARENT gutters, no labels. Each square fills its own32x32 pixel tile with fully OPAQUE material; display enlarged nearest-neighbor, sharp square pixels, no perspective, no lightinggradient, no highlights, no castshadows, no outsideborder. Toprow: asphalt-a, asphalt-b, yard-a. Bottomrow: yard-b, tiled-floor-a, tiled-floor-b. asphalt pair dark desaturated gray brown aggregate #242321 #393733 #4B4842 #777268, subtle sparse tiny pebbles and gentle non-directional wear, no major cracks or puddle crossingedge. yard pair slightly warmer grayconcrete #4B4842 #777268 #A49B88 muted #75634E, weathered finegrit, sparse moss2-3 pixels #59604A, no tuft or raisedobject. Tiled-floor pair worn gray beige16x16floor tiles with very thin groutline: NATIVE x15 and31, y15 and31 in32x32; exactly fourtiles per swatch, equivalent colors, no checkerboardcontrast. Grout #4B4842, tile #A49B88 #C9C0AC with tiny restrainedwear. Each variant same material average brightness, repeats in3x3mustblend, seamless tile boundary with no frame around swatch and no distinguishable edge decoration. Use3-5flatcolors per material. No text, characters, buildings or items. Square swatches equal size with clean separation.
carbine: ONE isolated pixel-art horizontal carbine overlay asset on fully transparent background. Side/top hybrid exactly orthographic, barrel points RIGHT, no perspective, no diagonal tilt. Design at NATIVE31pixels wide by10pixels tall, enlarged by nearest-neighbor to readable size. The horizontal barrel axis is native row4, muzzle at native(28,4), grip pivot at native(8,4). Gun silhouette reaches roughlyx1..29,y1..8. A short weathered muted brown stock at left, dark desaturated gray steel receiver center and narrow horizontal barrel pointing right. TWO SMALL NEUTRAL DARK GLOVED HANDS included in this weapon asset, primary hand aroundgrip atx8row4, support hand nearx18row4; gloves #4a463c, no arms, no bare skin, no person. Pixel edges and solid flat colors only, no antialiasing. Restrained ramps steel #242321 #393733 #4B4842 #777268, wood #75634E #784D3D #A27351; 3to5colors permaterial. No text or logos, no castshadow or floor or glow, no loose bullets. The asset is an attachable overlay for32x48player bodies. Keep the background empty and transparent. Do not include other guns or rotated duplicates.
